scope: Complete preassigned TRAIN/development sensory replay only; fixed author weights, no fitting or vehicle actuation
gpu_policy: One owned GPU replay/audit child at a time, only after collection is actually terminal; do not terminate foreign GPU users
history_policy: Every observation, original clock and held interval; one initialization per original lease, four independent author states; no slicing or hidden neural resets
roles: Skip evaluation before opening any recording/receipt/array. Do not change roles or reclassify failed recordings.
failure_policy: Keep original failures; never restart child on timeout. A terminal incomplete collection can prepare only its audited completed prefix, explicitly marked incomplete.
